description: doc-service-py: FastAPI document-processing service. Implements the REAL parse-job lifecycle, ParserRouter + EngineAdapter interface (with CPU-safe STUB engines returning sample canonical blocks), Normalizer emitting the exact canonical schema, validation (magic-byte MIME detection + SHA-256 + hash-based result cache), in-memory JobStore, structured JSON logging with the full correlation chain, and health endpoints. Heavy ML deps (docling, paddleocr/paddlepaddle, firecrawl pdf-inspector, sentence-transformers, pymupdf) are LAZY-imported behind the stub engines so the service boots and tests pass on CPU with no models installed. Depends on FEAT-001 for the canonical schema definition.
steps: Create docmind/doc-service-py/requirements.txt pinning base runtime: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], pydantic (v2), python-magic-bin (Windows-friendly) OR python-magic with a note, python-multipart, structlog (or stdlib logging configured as JSON). Create docmind/doc-service-py/requirements-ml.txt (OPTIONAL, not installed in CI) pinning the heavy/uncertain deps: pymupdf, docling, paddlepaddle (CPU), paddleocr, firecrawl pdf-inspector binding, sentence-transformers. Add a comment that requirements-ml.txt is optional and engines fall back to stubs when imports fail.

Create package app/ with app/main.py (FastAPI app factory, router registration, JSON-logging init on startup) and app/config.py (pydantic-settings: DOCMIND_LOG_LEVEL, DOCMIND_PERSIST_ARTIFACTS flag, host/port 8091, model names for later).

Create app/schema.py: pydantic models for Block, Document, Chunk, JobStatus matching docmind/docs/canonical-schema.md EXACTLY (type Enum with heading|paragraph|table|formula|key_value|checkbox|image|list; latex Optional and only set for formula; bbox as 4-float tuple; parse_engine Enum paddleocr|docling|pymupdf|office; heading_path list[str]; stats.engine_breakdown dict[str,int]). Include a validator asserting latex is only present when type==formula.

Create app/logging_config.py: structured JSON logger emitting one JSON object per line with fields: ts, level, stage, document_id, job_id, page, block_id, engine, duration_ms, confidence, msg. Provide a bind/context helper so each stage logs with the current correlation fields. Read an incoming X-Correlation-Id header (set by Java) and include it as correlation_id on every line for a request.

Create app/validation.py: detect_mime(bytes) using python-magic magic-byte sniffing (NOT file extension) with a safe fallback mapping; sha256_hex(bytes); and a simple size guard. Log stage=validate and stage=detect-mime (with detected mime + reason).

Create app/engines/base.py defining EngineAdapter (abstract: name:str, version:str, supports(page_kind)->bool, parse(payload, ctx)->list[Block]) and PageKind enum (TEXT_SIMPLE, TEXT_COMPLEX, SCANNED, FORMULA, OFFICE, WEB). Create app/engines/stub_engines.py with concrete stub adapters: PyMuPdfEngine, DoclingEngine, PaddleOcrEngine, OfficeEngine (and a formula-capable path) — each lazy-imports its real lib inside parse() wrapped in try/except ImportError and ALWAYS falls back to returning deterministic sample canonical Blocks (with realistic bbox, confidence, heading_path, correct parse_engine + parse_version) so the service runs without models. Log stage=parse with engine name, duration_ms, mean confidence.

Create app/router.py: ParserRouter.classify(mime, bytes) -> per-page PageKind decisions. For PDFs, call a classify_pdf(bytes) that (lazy) uses pdf-inspector when available else a heuristic stub, returning per-page kind + a human-readable reason; log stage=classify per page (text vs scanned + reason). Map office/md/html/xlsx/pptx/docx to OFFICE, formula pages to FORMULA. Route each page to the matching EngineAdapter.

Create app/normalizer.py: assemble engine Block outputs into a Document — assign global reading `order`, fill source{filename,sha256,mime,pages}, compute stats.engine_breakdown (block count per engine), validate against app/schema.py. Log stage=normalize.

Create app/jobs.py: in-memory JobStore (dict) with create(job_id, meta), set_status, set_page_progress, set_result, get. Statuses: queued, running, succeeded, failed. Add a hash-based result cache keyed by sha256 so re-submitting an identical file returns the cached Document without re-parsing (log a cache hit). Add TODO comments to move store+cache to Postgres/queue later.

Create app/service.py tying it together: process_parse_job runs validate -> detect-mime -> classify(per page) -> route+parse(per page via engines) -> normalize -> store result; updates per-page progress and job status; honors DOCMIND_PERSIST_ARTIFACTS (when true, write rendered page images / raw per-engine output under an artifacts/ dir keyed by job_id — stub-write placeholder files is fine). Run the job in a FastAPI BackgroundTask so POST returns 202 immediately.

Create app/api.py with routes: POST /v1/parse (accepts multipart file; returns 202 + {job_id, document_id, cached:bool}); GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} (status + per-page progress + engine_breakdown-so-far); GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/result (canonical Document JSON, 404 if not done); GET /healthz (liveness, always 200 when process up); GET /readyz (readiness: returns which optional ML libs are importable, but still 200 because stubs make the service ready). All handlers read X-Correlation-Id and bind the logging context.

Create docmind/doc-service-py/Dockerfile (python:3.11-slim; install build deps for python-magic/libmagic1; pip install base requirements.txt only; copy app/; CMD uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8091). Create a .dockerignore.

Create tests/ (pytest + fastapi TestClient): test_health (healthz/readyz 200), test_validation (sha256 deterministic; magic-byte mime detection on a tiny PDF/PNG byte sample), test_parse_flow (POST /v1/parse -> 202 job_id; poll job -> succeeded; result conforms to schema with blocks, engine_breakdown, global order), test_cache (same bytes twice -> second response cached:true, no re-parse), test_schema (latex rejected on non-formula block). Create tests/conftest.py and a README snippet for running `python -m pytest -q`.
acceptance_criteria: `python -c "import app.main"` succeeds in a venv with ONLY requirements.txt installed (no ML libs, no model downloads).

POST /v1/parse returns HTTP 202 with a job_id; GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} transitions to succeeded with per-page progress; GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/result returns a Document that validates against app/schema.py (blocks have block_id, page, order, type, bbox, confidence, parse_engine, parse_version; stats.engine_breakdown populated).
MIME is determined by magic bytes, not the filename extension (a .txt-named file with PDF magic bytes is detected as application/pdf).
Re-submitting identical bytes returns a cached result (cached:true) and logs a cache hit without re-running engines.

Every log line is valid JSON and carries the correlation chain fields (correlation_id, document_id, job_id, and page/block_id where applicable) and a `stage` field; the stages validate/detect-mime/classify/parse/normalize all appear during a parse.
GET /readyz reports importability of optional ML libs but the service is ready via stubs.
verification: cd docmind/doc-service-py && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r requirements.txt (Windows) and run: .venv\Scripts\python -m pytest -q  (all pass).
.venv\Scripts\python -c "import app.main; print('import ok')"  (no ImportError from heavy ML libs).

Boot locally: .venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8091 then curl http://localhost:8091/healthz and /readyz (200), POST a small file to /v1/parse (202), poll /v1/jobs/{id} and /v1/jobs/{id}/result. Confirm JSON log lines include stage + correlation fields.
findings:
doc-service-py (FastAPI parser) implemented, wired, and verified. VERIFICATION (Windows, Python 3.14 host; Docker uses python:3.11-slim): venv + `pip install -r requirements.txt` (base only, NO ML libs) -> `python -c "import app.main"` prints 'import ok' (no ImportError); `python -m pytest -q` = 15 passed (1 harmless StarletteDeprecationWarning). Live uvicorn smoke confirmed: POST /v1/parse -> 202; job -> succeeded with per-page progress (1/1) and engine_breakdown {pymupdf:2}; result validates against app/schema.py with monotonic global order [0,1]; a .txt-named file with %PDF magic bytes detected as application/pdf (magic-byte, not extension); identical resubmit -> cached:true via sha256 result cache with a logged cache hit; every log line is JSON carrying stage + correlation chain (stages validate/detect-mime/classify/parse/normalize all present).

CONTRACT FOR FEAT-003 (Java client MUST match these):
- BASE URL / PORT: http://localhost:8091 (uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8091; compose service name 'doc-service-py', in-network URL http://doc-service-py:8091, matching DOC_SERVICE_BASE_URL default). PORT env var overrides (pydantic-settings; also HOST). Config env: DOCMIND_LOG_LEVEL (default INFO), DOCMIND_PERSIST_ARTIFACTS (default false).
- CORRELATION HEADER NAME: 'X-Correlation-Id' (sent by Java on every call; echoed into logs as correlation_id). FastAPI reads it via Header alias x_correlation_id; header name is case-insensitive.
- ENDPOINTS (/v1 contract):
  * POST /v1/parse  -> 202. Request: multipart/form-data, field name EXACTLY 'file'. Response JSON: {"job_id": string(UUID), "document_id": string(UUID), "cached": bool}. When cached==true the job is already succeeded (no background work scheduled).
  * GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} -> 200 (404 if unknown). Response JSON: {job_id, document_id, status, filename, sha256, cached, pages_total(int), pages_done(int), page_progress:[{page,kind,status,block_count}], engine_breakdown:{engine:count}, error:string|null}. status enum: queued|running|succeeded|failed. page_progress[].status: pending|parsing|done.
  * GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}/result -> 200 canonical Document JSON (model_dump mode=json); 404 while not succeeded (body {error, status}). Document shape is EXACTLY docmind/docs/canonical-schema.md: Document{document_id, source{filename,sha256,mime,pages}, blocks[Block], stats{engine_breakdown:{engine:int}}}; Block{block_id,page,order,type,text,markdown,html,latex(null unless type==formula),bbox[x0,y0,x1,y1],confidence,heading_path[],parse_engine,parse_version}. type enum heading|paragraph|table|formula|key_value|checkbox|image|list; parse_engine enum paddleocr|docling|pymupdf|office (MinerU deferred, NOT valid). Enums serialize as their lowercase string values (use_enum_values).
  * GET /healthz -> 200 {"status":"ok"} (liveness).
  * GET /readyz -> 200 {"status":"ready","ready":true,"optional_ml_libs":{fitz,docling,paddleocr,paddle,sentence_transformers,pdf_inspector: bool},"persist_artifacts":bool}. Always 200 (stubs keep service ready even with no ML libs).
- ASYNC PATTERN: POST returns 202 immediately; parsing runs in a FastAPI BackgroundTask. Java should POST then poll GET /v1/jobs/{id} until status==succeeded (or failed), then GET .../result. On a cache hit the result is available immediately.
- ENGINES: EngineAdapter interface (app/engines/base.py) + stub engines (PyMuPdf/Docling/PaddleOcr/Office) that lazy-import real libs inside parse() and fall back to deterministic sample canonical blocks; requirements-ml.txt is OPTIONAL and NOT installed in CI. ParserRouter.classify_pdf uses pdf-inspector when available else a byte heuristic for per-page TEXT_SIMPLE/TEXT_COMPLEX/SCANNED/FORMULA.
- DEPENDENCY NOTE: requirements.txt uses floor pins (>=) rather than hard == so wheels resolve on both Python 3.11 (Docker/CI) and newer local interpreters (3.14 has no cp314 wheel for the originally-pinned pydantic 2.10.4 which forced a Rust source build); pydantic>=2.11 ships cp314 wheels. Dockerfile stays on python:3.11-slim and installs libmagic1 for the optional python-magic cross-check (the built-in byte sniffer in app/validation.py is the authoritative detector and needs no native lib).
